justification.text: `2 ^ n - 1` cannot truncate, because 2^n ≥ 1 for every natural n, so 2^n − 1 is the genuine Mersenne number the conjecture is about ('the addition-chain length of 2^n − 1').
`n - 1` cannot truncate, because the statement assumes 0 < n, i.e. n ≥ 1, so n − 1 is the genuine value in the conjectured bound n − 1 + ℓ(n) 'for every positive integer n'.
